headline: Generadora de Luz del Sur Plans Hydroelectric and Renewable Expansion
summary: Inland Energy, a generator under Luz del Sur, is developing the Santa Teresa II hydroelectric project in Cusco and plans to expand its wind and solar parks in 2027 with US$30 million, aiming for 1,000 MW by 2030.
why: Utility infrastructure investments expand power generation capacity and support long-term renewable energy targets for regional electricity markets.
